description: Reflexive and symmetric closures are the least relations with the required properties.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Relations.elementary_closures_least.{u} {α : Type u} (R S : α → α → Prop) :
  (Std.Refl S → R ≤ S → Relation.ReflGen R ≤ S) ∧ (Std.Symm S → R ≤ S → Relation.SymmGen R ≤ S)
